ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) mottling distributed across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation with irregular white mottling. Significant high-intensity clustering is observed on the distal posterior margin of the right lobe and scattered across the central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate internal pixel angle of 45 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in amplitude along the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch, tapering into an upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-intensity pixel clusters (scars) are visible, particularly concentrated on the medial and distal portions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several thin, unaligned high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity, textured protrusions (barnacles) are present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. The right tip shows distinctive pinkish-red tissue exposure within the barnacle cluster.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pinkish pigmentation and irregular fleshy topography localized specifically on the right distal fluke tip.
